audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds by design: the conditional at L2185 `if !origin.is_from_el()` intentionally skips KZG proof verification (L2195) and inclusion proof verification (L2188) for data sourced from the local execution layer via `engine_getBlobsV2`. This reflects an explicit trust boundary where the local EL is treated as a trusted component. All P2P-sourced data (Gossip, Requested, BackSync, Api origins) undergoes full cryptographic validation.
